name: College of Glamour
summary: Bards touched by the Feywild who beguile crowds with otherworldly grace.

features.name: Mantle of Inspiration
features.short: Bonus action: allies gain temp HP and move without provoking.
features.summary: As a bonus action, expend a Bardic Inspiration to grant up to CHA-modifier creatures within 60 ft. 5 temporary hit points (8 at 5th, 11 at 10th, 14 at 15th). Each can immediately use its reaction to move up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

features.name: Enthralling Performance
features.summary: If you perform for at least 1 minute, choose up to CHA-modifier humanoids who watched: each makes a WIS save or is charmed by you for 1 hour, idolizing you. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Mantle of Majesty
features.short: Bonus action: cast Command each turn for a minute.
features.summary: As a bonus action, you cast Command without a slot and take on unearthly beauty for 1 minute (concentration). During it you can cast Command as a bonus action each turn without a slot; charmed creatures fail the save. Once per long rest.

features.name: Unbreakable Majesty
features.short: Attackers must save or pick another target.
features.summary: As a bonus action, for 1 minute, a creature that attacks you for the first time on a turn makes a CHA save; on a failure it must choose a new target or lose the attack, and has disadvantage on saves against your spells. Once per short or long rest.
